title: Saviynt — Staff Product Operations Manager
sourceNote: Live Worker smoke test against a current public role listing.
roleBrief:
Saviynt — Staff Product Operations Manager

Lead cross-functional product operations in enterprise software. Build roadmap presentations that connect data insights to strategic decisions. Maintain AI-native workflows using Claude Code to automate roadmap assembly, surface product-data insights and prepare executive-ready materials. Own customer and field-feedback capture, synthesis and routing. Coordinate complex initiatives across Product, Marketing and Support. The role needs hands-on AI workflow experience, strong planning, collaboration, analytics, scalable systems, customer empathy and the ability to turn business needs into actionable product inputs.

assessment.summary: The candidate’s public evidence demonstrates experience in product operations, workflow design, AI-native execution, evidence synthesis, operational collaboration, technical delivery, and business prioritisation. The role requires AI-workflow experience, planning, collaboration, analytics, scalable systems, customer empathy, and translating business needs into product inputs. The evidence supports most dimensions directly, with some needing verification.
